FACULTY OF ENGINEERING
B.E. (BL) Degree Examination
Code No. : E-5002/O/BL
Subject : BS 204 CH — Engineering Chemistry
September/October, 2023
Time: 3 hours                         Max. Marks: 70

PART-A
Answer any five questions. (5x2 = 10 Marks)
1. Define electrochemical cell.
2. Explain Nernst equation.
3. What is reference electrode?
4. Define hardness of water.
5. Explain EDTA method.
6. What is corrosion?
7. Define polymer.
8. Explain calorific value.
9. What is green chemistry?
10. Define composite material.

PART-B
Answer any four questions. (4x15 = 60 Marks)
11 a) Explain electrochemical series and its applications.
    b) Discuss fuel cells in detail.
12 a) Explain EDTA method for estimation of hardness.
    b) Discuss reverse osmosis for water treatment.
13 a) Explain conducting polymers.
    b) Discuss thermoplastic and thermoset polymers.
14 a) Explain proximate analysis of coal.
    b) Discuss octane and cetane rating of fuels.
15 a) Explain principles of green chemistry.
    b) Describe biodiesel production by transesterification.
16 a) Explain composite classification.
    b) Write applications of composites.
17 Write any two questions:
    a) Explain Nernst equation / EMF
    b) Fuel cells
    c) Corrosion control methods
